# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

I only have review pages for most of these, not direct retailer links, so those picks link to the reviews. The ESR CryoBoost is the only one with a direct buy link.

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges the Apple Watch (Series 7 or newer), and has an AirPods pad on the base.
- The phone pad tilts, supports landscape for StandBy mode, and the warranty is 2 years.
- List price is $109, and WIRED lists it at $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy base that allows one-handed pickup.
- It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25).
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**
- WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It charges the iPhone at 15W, includes the charger and cable, and the Watch charger detaches for travel.
- It's listed at $40 (down from $80) on Amazon, but the warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It lifts the iPhone about 70mm and has a 160° tilt.
- It includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.
- It weighs 399g, which is heavier than the ESR and Kuxiu travel stands.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Best compact travel option: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2)**
- It folds slim, charges the iPhone at 15W, and has a 40W adapter and a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at $80, down from $110.
- [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W): the one with a direct buy link**
- It's a folding stand with a quiet cooling fan that you can switch off, and a 50W adapter is included.
- WIRED says it's more expensive than ESR's previous model and the speed gain probably isn't worth it for overnight charging.
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99, or $82 with code **PARTNER18** (tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25).
- [Buy from ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through this link, at no extra cost to you. Check the final price at checkout.

**Before you buy**
- The 25W speeds only apply to iPhone 16 and 17 series. Other iPhones get 15W, and WIRED and Macworld both say the difference matters little for overnight charging.
- Your AirPods case needs to support wireless charging.
- Prices change often, so confirm them at checkout.

If you mostly charge overnight, I'd go with the Belkin or the budget ESR. If you want a desk stand that also travels, the Satechi is the better choice.
